speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a rope's end on the bench. I am looking at it. I am not picking it up, and I am not asking it what it was for.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then look, and be done. A property that is lying still is doing its work. You have a habit of promoting them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not this one. It can lie. If someone comes off with a story about it, the story can arrive on its own feet.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Someone will. They always do, when the yard has made a noise. Keep your hands in your lap until he has spent it.
